deferred_data_gate_context.route_policy: Keep data acquisition explicit, but do not let it preempt the bare link evaluator core unless the user asks for data work.

complete_definition.meaning: The graph is complete when a medium sub-agent can execute any ready node from explicit inputs and acceptance criteria without inventing strategy, and when the path to the project goal begins with a real machine-readable colored framed link evaluator, then ordinary Kirby-color sums, then twisted/decorated sums, then certified exotic-pair computation.
complete_definition.not_meaning: Complete does not mean the formula is proved, the exotic pair is available, or the resulting theory is production-grade. It means the routing and evidence obligations are explicit enough to execute without ad hoc judgment.

execution_policy.anti_overthinking_rule: Do not begin no-go analysis merely because a first small example is boring; compute more examples or another category unless a gate says the formula is not meaningful.
execution_policy.recording_rule: Each completed node appends a CTL claim or lab-note/artifact object with commands, outputs, exact artifacts, confidence status, and next edge.
execution_policy.routing_rule: When a node fails by a listed failure condition, follow the matching edge instead of re-planning from scratch.
subagent_ready_when: node can output artifact paths or a CTL claim

invariants: Agents must use the current graph projection by default; old graph revisions are historical evidence, not the day-to-day plan.
No result may be called a twisted Yetter calculator output unless it is derived from machine-readable Kirby/link diagram input through the colored framed link evaluator.
Matrix/intersection-form statistics are auxiliary sanity checks only and cannot satisfy link-evaluator, surgery, decorated, or exotic-computation gates.
Yetter Z/2 surgical formula is provisional-low-confidence until source-audited and checked; general Omega_a is candidate-experimental until proved or sourced.
Passing many examples provides evidence for a candidate formula, not theorem-level proof.
No exotic-pair computation before link controls, ordinary controls, candidate formula validation, and decorated Kirby-move/presentation gates pass.
No terminal positive claim without exact artifact comparison and certified input marking.
No no-go conclusion from low-rank negative controls alone.
Equal values on a first exotic pair route to more computation, not theory no-go.
Every completed node must produce a reproducible artifact or a CTL lab-note claim.
Graph changes are append-only at CTL object level: new graph revisions parent the prior active graph revision.
Blocked executable gates must not advance along pass edges: data-blocked n70 and dry-run-blocked n75 route to data acquisition, not n80.
Bare colored framed link evaluation is the first hard calculator deliverable; Kirby color is necessary downstream but cannot substitute for it.
Guardrail ledgers are useful only if they do not preempt the evaluator core when the current goal is computation.
